profile.name: PI C-867双轴压电定位台
profile.name_en: PI C-867 Two-Axis Piezo Positioning Stage
profile.description: 用于控制PI C-867相关的双轴压电/纳米定位平台，可进行XY位置读取、绝对与相对移动、速度设置、伺服开关和参考初始化，常用于显微成像中的精密扫描、样品对准和纳米级定位。
profile.description_en: A PI C-867-based two-axis piezo/nanopositioning stage used for XY position readout, absolute and relative motion, velocity setting, servo control, and reference initialization. It is typically used for precision scanning, sample alignment, and nanometer-scale positioning in microscopy.
